result.instructions: Tools for BigTime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many hours did each person on my team log last week?"; "Which projects are over budget this month?"; "List all draft invoices and the client for each.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BigTime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bigtime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bigtime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bigtime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bigtime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bigtime_list_staff

tools.description: List staff members (id = staff sid, name, email). Good first call. BigTime API: GET /staff.

tools.name: bigtime_get_staff

tools.description: Get one staff member by staff sid. BigTime API: GET /staff/detail/{sid}.

tools.description: Get one project by sid, with budget, dates and billing setup. BigTime API: GET /project/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_project_team

tools.description: List the staff assigned to a project. BigTime API: GET /project/team/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_clients
tools.title: List clients

tools.name: bigtime_get_client

tools.name: bigtime_run_report
tools.title: Run a saved report
tools.description: Run a saved BigTime report and return its rows. Pass the report filters as a JSON object, for example {"DT_BEGIN":"2026-01-01","DT_END":"2026-01-31"}. Read only. BigTime API: POST /report/data/{id}.

tools.name: bigtime_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create a time entry
tools.description: WRITE: log time for a staff member on a project. Creates a new time entry in BigTime (it does not replace one). Set mark_submitted to submit it for approval at once. BigTime API: POST /time.

staff_sid.description: Staff sid the time belongs to.

task_sid.description: Optional task sid on the project.

mark_submitted.description: Submit the entry for approval (default false).
